title: QMT135 2025 — official race recap
claims: The 2025 QMT135 was the brand-new 135 km race; Xavier St-Cyr won in 17:18:05 and Maryline Nakache in 19:11:41, both marked as new course records.
The 2025 men's podium was Xavier St-Cyr 17:18:05, Matthieu Saliou 17:43:32 and Sébastien Camus 19:00:02.
The 2025 women's podium was Maryline Nakache 19:11:41, Geneviève Nadeau 20:26:04 and Mylène Sansoucy 20:33:31; Nakache was also fourth overall.
The 2025 weekend continued on Sunday 6 July with the QMT25, QMT15, QMT6 and a 1 km kids race.

verification.note: 2026-11-21 直接读取官方赛后稿全文。页面未印发布日期；正文称 brand-new QMT135，且 2025 官方 launch 说明 135 公里自 2025 起取代 QMT100 Miles 与 QMT110，因此归为 2025 届。
